title: Building Quantum-Ready Infrastructure: Preparing for the Physical Demands of Quantum Computing
summary_en: To avoid delays similar to the ones that the AI industry has experienced, the U.S. quantum industry needs to strengthen its supply chains for cryogenics, laser, optics, and other materials. Governments, firms, laboratories, and universities have a rare planning window.
